protocol.multiple_comparisons: Holm-adjusted paired permutation p-values; separately labelled Bonferroni simultaneous paired-bootstrap intervals
protocol.timing_limitation: shared-machine observational timing; reused and fresh vector cells are not causal latency comparisons
